critical_code_review_comments: patients.py bulk-import is well-structured: separate _parse_csv (encoding fallback utf-8-sig→utf-8→latin-1, delimiter sniffer) + _parse_xlsx (read_only data_only) + _parse_patient_row (handles datetime/date objects, gender variants es/en, DD/MM/YYYY+ISO).
Pre-fetching existing identifiers into existing_nat / existing_composite sets is O(N) and correct; case-insensitive on national_id is consistent in both directions.

Composite key f"{fn}|{ln}|{phone}" uses lowercase trim — robust against accidental leading/trailing whitespace. Note: phone is NOT normalized (no digits-only stripping), so '+502 5555-0100' vs '50255550100' would NOT collide — acceptable given national_id is the primary key.
Endpoint correctly uses /clinic/patients-bulk/* prefix to avoid colliding with /clinic/patients/{patient_id} validate_uuid path.
Returns committed=False when commit_errors is non-empty (good signaling), unlike the iter23 catalogs.py which returned committed=True even when imported=0.
Required-field validation runs per-row with try/except ValueError — clean control flow.
CsvImportDialog ENDPOINT_MAP is extensible and the acceptXlsx prop is correctly threaded into both file accept attribute and template button visibility. Title and hint text are correctly conditional.
PatientsPage import button correctly placed (variant=outline, teal-600) next to primary new-patient button — visual hierarchy preserved.
Minor: errors[] is capped at 50 (good); commit_errors is separate (good DX vs iter23 mixed approach).
